answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in escrow before it may trade, with random audits that slash the bond of any identity caught lying about its work. A grove of fake accounts becomes a field of frozen deposits: each sybil costs real capital, and the audit lottery means an attacker cannot know which identity will be checked next. Like basalt, the bond is hard and slow to accumulate, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents pass audits and reclaim their stake with a quill-stamped receipt, keeping the market open while making forgery unprofitable.
